evidence.quote: rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on

observations.why: Mandating a recurring rehearsal cadence appeals to security/stability (conservation) and to maintaining capability (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Equating unrehearsed rollback with not having one frames rehearsal as the proof of genuine capability, appealing to competence and security.
Specifying a fixed cadence for rehearsals appeals to stability and security through regularity.
Naming an owner appeals to standing and accountability as the good that secures the practice.
